'''Kajim''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an automated Imperial surveillance ship crashed on Kajim, though Imperial operatives were able to drive off the Republic retrieval team and reclaim it for the Empire.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Data Race}}</ref>
